blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Building foundation models for MRI has emerged as a promising direction for advancing medical image analysis and improving accessibility of task specific models. Existing approaches primarily focus on effective pretraining strategies and evaluating their performance across diverse downstream tasks. While these methods show performance gains, limited attention has been given to understanding task alignment between pretraining and downstream objectives. Unlike language models, where the two stages are naturally aligned, such alignment is less evident in vision based applications. Motivated by this gap, we explore continual pretraining. Specifically, continually pretraining a pretrained ViT encoder using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) on a prostate segmentation task to enhance task alignment and downstream performance. We further perform layer-wise representational analysis using Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) to assess representational shifts and their correlation with task outcomes. Our experiments show improved performance in 3 of 6 downstream tasks and comparable results in the others. Our Feature analysis reveals that, for segmentation tasks, continually pretrained encoder features exhibit greater similarity to those of the finetuned encoder than the original pretrained encoder, correlating with observed performance gains.
blocks.zh: 建立核磁共振的基础模型已成为推进医疗图像分析和改进具体任务模型的可获性的一个有希望的方向。 现有办法主要侧重于有效的培训前战略,并评价这些战略在各种下游任务中的业绩。 虽然这些方法显示出业绩的提高,但对于理解培训前目标和下游目标之间的任务协调重视有限。 与两个阶段自然对齐的语言模型不同,这种对齐在基于视觉的应用中不那么明显. 基于这一差距,我们探索继续预先训练。 具体地说,在前列腺分解任务上,利用低RANK适应(LORA)不断预先训练一个预先训练的ViT编码器,以加强任务对接和下游性能. 我们进一步利用核心核心内核对齐(CKA)进行分层代表分析,以评估代表的变化及其与任务结果的相关性。 我们的实验显示,在6项下游任务中,有3项任务的业绩有所改善,其他任务则有类似的结果。 我们的特性分析显示,对于分解任务来说,持续经过预先训练的编码器特性与经过微调的编码器的特性相比,与原先经过预先训练的编码器更为相似,与观察到的性能增益相关。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Prostate MRI has an important role in reducing number of biopsies and damage to surrounding tissues during clinical diagnosis [ 1 ] . With the help of AI models, automation of information extraction, such as lesion segmentation, can further enhance clinical decision making [ 2 ] . Traditionally, independent models have been developed for different tasks, which is resource intensive, limits practical deployment, and hinders generalisation to out-of-distribution data [ 3 ] . Motivated by the success of large language models (LLMs), recent efforts to develop large scale medical vision models have shown considerable promise but continue to face several limitations. Notably, features learned through both general-purpose [ 4 ] and domain-specific [ 5 ] pretraining have not consistently translated to strong performance in medical downstream tasks, often requiring extensive task-specific fine-tuning. Although various pretraining strategies such as MAE, DINO, and CLIP have been explored [ 6 , 7 ] , each offering task-dependent advantages, they still seem to lack balanced representations for capturing the shared semantics across downstream tasks [ 8 ] .
blocks.zh: 前列腺核磁共振在减少临床诊断期间的活检次数和对周围组织的损害方面起重要作用 [1]. 在AI模型的帮助下,诸如损伤分解等信息提取的自动化可以进一步加强临床决策[2]. 传统上,为不同任务开发出独立的模型,这些模型是资源密集型的,限制了实际部署,并阻碍了对分配外数据的概括化[3]. 在大型语言模型(LLMs)的成功推动下,最近为开发大型医学视觉模型而作的努力显示出了相当大的希望,但继续面临若干限制。 值得注意的是,通过普通用途[4]和具体领域[5]的预先培训学到的特征并没有一致地转化为医疗下游任务的强效表现,往往需要针对具体任务进行广泛的微调。 尽管对MAE、DINO和CLIP等各种培训前战略进行了探讨[6、7],每个战略都具有依赖于任务的优势,但它们似乎仍然缺乏平衡的表述,无法掌握下游任务的共同语义[8]。

blocks.en: In this work, we propose a continual pretraining approach aimed at improving the learning of shared downstream task representations. Continual pretraining generally involves further pretraining an already pretrained encoder to better align its learned features with those relevant to downstream tasks. A recent study [ 8 ] explored a similar idea by continually pretraining self-supervised DINOv2 and supervised CLIP models on domain-specific data at scales of 30k, 50k, 100k, 1M, and 1.3M samples, reporting consistent performance improvements with larger in-domain datasets—where, in some cases, as few as 30k samples outperformed the original pretrained weights. While our dataset is considerably smaller, we nevertheless observe improved performance in several in-domain and out-of-domain downstream tasks.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们建议采取持续的培训前方法,以更好地学习共同的下游任务说明。 连续的预训一般涉及进一步预训一个已经经过预训的编码器,以更好地使其所学的特征与下游任务相关。 最近的一项研究[8]探索了类似的想法,不断预先训练自我监督的DINOv2和在30k、50k、100k、1M和1.3M样本的域内特定数据上监督的CLIP模型,报告在更大域内数据集方面一贯的性能改进——在某些情况下,只有30k样本的成绩超过了原先预先训练的重量。 虽然我们的数据集要小得多,但我们看到一些内域和外域任务的执行情况有所改善。

blocks.en: Specifically, we employ a pretrained Vision Transformer (ViT) encoder [ 9 ] trained using 5,524 3D prostate MRI scans on a self-supervised Masked Autoencoder (MAE) objective to capture multi-level general features from MRI data. We continually pretrain this encoder using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) [ 10 ] on a prostate segmentation task comprising 396 training and 113 test samples. The prostate segmentation task was chosen due to its close relevance to several downstream tasks, including prostate lesion and anatomical segmentation, PI-RADS score classification, and prostate volume regression. Across six downstream task examples, we observe performance improvements in three tasks following continual pretraining. Two of which involve segmentation, highlighting the significance of task similarity for achieving better alignment during continual pretraining.
blocks.zh: 具体地说,我们使用一个经过预先训练的ViT变形器[9]被训练的编码器,在自控的Masked自动编码器(MAE)目标上使用5,524个3D前列腺核磁共振扫描来捕捉磁共振数据的多层次的一般特性. 我们不断利用Low-Rank Resignation(Lora)[10]对这个编码器进行前列腺分解培训,包括396个培训和113个测试样本。 选择前列腺分解任务是因为它与几个下游任务密切相关,包括前列腺损伤和解剖分解,PI-RADS分数分类,和前列腺体积回归等. 在6个下游任务实例中,我们看到在持续进行预先培训后,三项任务的业绩有所改善。 其中两项涉及分门别类,突出了任务相似性对于在持续预训期间实现更好的协调的重要性。

blocks.en: To further analyse representational changes, we utilise the Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) similarity metric [ 11 ] to quantify pairwise feature representation similarities across three encoders: the pretrained baseline, the fine-tuned model (initialised from the pretrained encoder), and our continual pretrained encoder. We analyse the difference between CKA(pretrained, fine-tuned) and CKA(continual-pretrained, fine-tuned) to assess whether continual pretraining shifts the feature geometry closer to that of the fine-tuned model, indicating improved task alignment. Furthermore, we examine whether the change in representational similarity correlates with the downstream performance difference between fine-tuned models initialised from pretrained and continually pretrained encoders. Our results show that this correlation holds when a measurable representational similarity shift is observed, suggesting that geometric feature alignment is indeed important in improved downstream performance.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步分析代表性变化,我们利用中枢的克内尔对齐(CKA)相似度度测量[11],量化三个编码器的对等特征表示相似性:预先训练基线、微调模型(从预先训练的编码器起步)和持续训练的编码器。 我们分析CKA(经过培训、微调)和CKA(经过培训、微调)之间的差异,以评估持续进行预训是否使特征几何学与微调模型的几何学更接近,表明任务协调有所改善。 此外,我们审查代表性相似性的变化是否与经过微调的模型之间的下游性能差异相关。 我们的结果表明,当观察到可衡量代表性的相似性转变时,这种相关性就存在,这表明几何特征的一致对于改善下游业绩确实很重要。

blocks.en: 2 Method
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: 2.1 Applying LoRA to a Pretrained Encoder
blocks.zh: 2.1 将 LoRA 应用到预装编码器

Specifically, LoRA is integrated into the attention mechanism of each transformer block within the encoder. blocks.en: 2.2 Continual Pretraining
blocks.zh: 2.2 连续预训

blocks.en: During continual pretraining, the pretrained encoder weights W W are frozen, and an adapter module is used to connect a Unified Perceptual Parsing (UperNet) decoder for segmentation. The adapter receives hidden states { H i } i = 1 4 \{H_{i}\}_{i=1}^{4} from selected layers of the ViT encoder and reshapes each token sequence into a 3D feature map X i = Reshape ⁡ ( H i ) ∈ R B × C × D × H × W X_{i}=\mathrm{Reshape}(H_{i})\in{R}^{B\times C\times D\times H\times W} . The UperNet decoder integrates these multiscale feature maps by downsampling the first two and upsampling the last to align them to the spatial scale of the third map. The fused representation is then passed through a softmax classifier to produce voxel-level segmentation. LoRA parameters are trained to adapt the encoder from generating general features learned during pretraining to producing task-aligned representations more suitable for related downstream tasks.
blocks.zh: 在持续预训期间,被预训的编码器重W W被冷冻,并使用适配器模块来连接一个用于分解的"统一感知解析器"(UperNet). 适配器从 VIT 编码器的选定地层接收到隐藏状态 {H i } (i = 1 4 \{H_{i}\}_{i}^{i}^{ 1}^{4 },并将每个符号序列重塑为3D 特征图 X i = Reshape * (H i ) * * R B × C × D × H i}=\ mathrm { reshape} (H_{i}i})\ (R}^{B\times C\times D\times H\times W}). UperNet 解码器将这些多比例特征图通过对前两幅进行下标并上标来与第三幅图的空间尺度相匹配. 然后通过软马克斯分级器传递引信代表物,以产生活塞级分解. LoRA参数经过培训,可以使编码器从产生在预训期间学到的一般特性到产生更适合相关下游任务的与任务相匹配的表示.

blocks.en: 2.3 Downstream Tasks
blocks.zh: 2.3 下游任务

blocks.en: Following continual pretraining, the encoder’s original weights are unfrozen and evaluated across a range of downstream tasks using both in-domain (identical to continual pretraining data) and out-of-domain datasets, as summarised in Table 1 . To isolate encoder effects, we employ simple task specific heads. A lightweight two layer linear head is attached for prostate zone classification and prostate volume regression. For lesion and prostate zone segmentation, we employ the same UperNet decoder architecture. Finally, a super-resolution module from [ 12 ] is attached to the encoder to enhance low-resolution T 2 T_{2} inputs by a factor of four.
blocks.zh: 在不断进行预先训练之后,编码器的原重被解冻,并在一系列下游任务中使用(与持续预先训练数据相同)和域外数据集进行评估,如表1所概述。 为了隔离编码器效应,我们使用简单的任务特定头. 为前列腺区分级和前列腺体积还原而附加了轻量级两层线性头. 对于损伤和前列腺区分化,我们使用同样的UperNet解码器架构. 最后,编码器上还附加了[12]的超分辨率模块,以将低分辨率的T2 T_{2}输入乘以四.

blocks.en: 2.4 Geometric Feature Analysis Metric
blocks.zh: 2.4 几何特征分析计量

blocks.en: To analyse layer-wise representational similarity across the pretrained, continual-pretrained, and fine-tuned encoders, we employ the Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) similarity metric. CKA quantifies the degree to which two sets of feature representations encode similar geometric structures in their respective feature spaces. We compute pairwise CKA values between encoder layers (e.g. l 1 l_{1} and l 2 l_{2} ) for tasks exhibiting a performance difference of approximately 0.2 % 0.2\% or greater. For given layer outputs Z 1 ( l 1 ) Z_{1}^{(l_{1})} and Z 2 ( l 2 ) Z_{2}^{(l_{2})} from encoders Z 1 Z_{1} and Z 2 Z_{2} , the linear CKA similarity is defined as: CKA ⁡ ( Z 1 ( l 1 ) , Z 2 ( l 2 ) ) = ‖ Z 1 ( l 1 ) ⊤ ​ Z 2 ( l 2 ) ‖ F 2 ‖ Z 1 ( l 1 ) ⊤ ​ Z 1 ( l 1 ) ‖ F ​ ‖ Z 2 ( l 2 ) ⊤ ​ Z 2 ( l 2 ) ‖ F , \mathrm{CKA}\big(Z_{1}^{(l_{1})},Z_{2}^{(l_{2})}\big)=\frac{\|{Z_{1}^{(l_{1})}}^{\top}Z_{2}^{(l_{2})}\|_{F}^{2}}{\|{Z_{1}^{(l_{1})}}^{\top}Z_{1}^{(l_{1})}\|_{F}\;\|{Z_{2}^{(l_{2})}}^{\top}Z_{2}^{(l_{2})}\|_{F}}, (7) where ∥ ⋅ ∥ F \|\cdot\|_{F} denotes the Frobenius norm. In our experiments, CKA similarities are computed for layers 3, 5, 7, and 11 across the three encoders to evaluate how fine-tuning and continual pretraining influence internal feature representations relative to the pretrained baseline.

blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3个实验

blocks.en: 3.1 Dataset and Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集和实验设置

blocks.en: Four datasets were used in this study: PROMIS for continual pretraining, Anatomy for downstream anatomy segmentation, RISK for PIRADS score classification, and UCL Set for Prostate volume regression [ 13 , 14 , 15 ] . Their respective data splits, input modalities, and target outputs are summarised in Table 1 . All models were trained with an input size of ( 64,256,256 ) (64,256,256) , except for the super-resolution task where the depth dimension ( 64 64 ) was reduced by a factor of four. The inputs underwent standard preprocessing and augmentation procedures, including normalisation, centre cropping, random rotation, flipping, zooming, and intensity variation.
blocks.zh: 本研究使用了四个数据集: 用于持续预演的PROMIS,用于下游解剖分解的解剖学,用于PIRADS分数分类的RISC,以及用于前列腺体积回归的UCL Set[13,14,15]. 表1汇总了其各自的数据划分、输入方式和目标产出。 所有型号都经过了输入尺寸(64 256 256)的培训(64 256 256),但深度尺寸(64 64)减少为四倍的超分辨率任务除外。 投入经过了标准的预处理和增强程序,包括正常化、中心收成、随机旋转、翻转、放大和强度变化。

blocks.en: All experiments were conducted on an NVIDIA A40 GPU for 100 epochs. The Adam optimiser was used across all tasks, with Dice loss applied to segmentation, cross-entropy loss to classification, mean squared error (MSE) to regression, and mean absolute error (MAE) to super-resolution. Batch sizes were set to 4 4 for segmentation and super-resolution tasks, and 16 16 for classification and regression tasks.
blocks.zh: 所有实验都是在用于100个纪元的NVIDIA A40 GPU上进行的. Adam optimiser被应用于所有任务,Dice损失应用于分解,交叉通缩损失应用于分类,平均平方误差(MSE)用于回归,平均绝对误差(MAE)用于超解. 批量大小被设定为分化和超解任务为4个4个,分类和回归任务为16个16个.

blocks.en: 3.2 Results
blocks.zh: 3.2 结果

blocks.en: Model performance was compared across three configurations sharing identical architectures but differing in weight initialisation. The first, ViT Random Weights , was trained from scratch. The second, ProFound ViT OMW , initialised with pretrained encoder weights, served as the baseline. The third, ProFound ViT Ours , utilised our continually pretrained encoder weights.
blocks.zh: 在三个共享相同架构的配置中比较了模型性能,但在重量初始化方面有所不同。 第一个是VIT随机重量,从零开始训练。 第二部名为ProFound ViT OMW, 配有事先训练过的编码器重量,作为基线。 第三,ProFound ViT Ours, 利用我们不断训练的编码器重量。

blocks.en: Performance on Classification Tasks: Two classification tasks were evaluated. The first employed the RISK dataset for four-class PIRADS score classification (2–5), where higher scores indicate increased malignancy risk. The second used the PROMIS dataset for 20-zone prostate classification. As shown in Table 2 , for PIRADS classification, the baseline model achieved the highest overall AUC, outperforming our model by approximately 0.4 % 0.4\% . However, for AUC thresholds ≥ 3 \geq 3 and ≥ 4 \geq 4 , our model surpassed the baseline by over 5 % 5\% in AUC ≥ 3 \geq 3 , suggesting improved discrimination of higher-risk PIRADS scores. For zone classification, the baseline outperformed our model by 2.3 % 2.3\% on average.
blocks.zh: 分类业绩 任务 : 评价了两项分类任务。 第一个是使用RISK数据集进行四等PIRADS分数分类(2–5),其中较高的分数表明恶性风险增加. 第二套使用了20个区前列腺分类的PROMIS数据集. 如表2所示,在PIRADS分类方面,基准模型实现了最高的总的AUC,比我们的模型提高了大约0.4%.0.4%.。 然而,对于AUC的阈值 3\geq 3 和 4\geq 4,我们的模型在AUC 3\geq 3中超过了基准量的5% 5%,这表明对高风险的 PIRADS 分数有更好的区分。 就区划而言,基线业绩平均比我们的模型高出2.3% 2.3%。

blocks.en: Feature representation analysis (Section 3.2.5) revealed that encoder representations from the continually pretrained and finetuned models were highly similar to the pretrained encoder. This suggests that for classification tasks, globally learned representations during pretraining remain largely transferable, and performance differences are likely influenced by subtle variations in discriminative feature directions [ 16 ] .
blocks.zh: 特征表示分析(第3.2.5节)显示,不断经过训练并经过微调的模型中的编码器表示与经过训练的编码器高度相近。 这表明,就分类任务而言,在预训期间全球学习到的表述在很大程度上仍然是可转移的,绩效差异可能受到歧视性特征方向的细微变化的影响[16]。

blocks.en: Performance on Regression Task: As presented in Table 3 , regression results showed a marginal 0.2 % 0.2\% decrease compared to the baseline, indicating limited benefit of continual pretraining for this specific alignment task.
blocks.zh: 回归时的性能 任务 : 如表3所示,回归结果显示,与基准相比,下降幅度为0.2%.20%.,表明持续为这一具体调整任务进行预先培训的好处有限。

blocks.en: Performance on Segmentation Tasks: We evaluated two segmentation tasks: lesion segmentation using the PROMIS dataset and prostate zone segmentation using the Anatomy dataset (eight zones in total). Table 4 shows that our model outperformed the baseline by approximately 0.5 % 0.5\% in average Dice score for lesion segmentation and 0.1 % 0.1\% for zone segmentation. These improvements suggest that continual pretraining on a similar segmentation task enhances alignment for downstream segmentation objectives. This observation is further examined in Section 3.1.1, where representational similarity is analysed.
blocks.zh: 分块性能 任务 : 我们评价了两项分解任务:利用ProMIS数据集进行损害分解,利用解剖学数据集进行前列腺区分解(共8个区)。 表4显示,我们的模型在损伤分解的平均剂量分数中超过基线约0.5%.5%.%.,在区分解中则超过0.1%. 这些改进表明,继续就类似的分块任务进行预先培训可加强下游分块目标的一致性。 第3.1.1节进一步审查了这一意见,其中分析了代表性的相似性。

blocks.en: Performance on Super-Resolution Task: Table 5 presents results for the super-resolution task, where the baseline model achieved a slightly higher SSIM ( 0.1 % 0.1\% improvement). Similar to the regression case, continual pretraining did not yield improved task alignment for this setting.
blocks.zh: 超分辨率的性能 任务:表5列出了超分辨率任务的结果,基线模型实现了略高的SSIM(0.1%.0.1%. 与回归情况类似,持续的预训无法改进这一设置的任务协调。

blocks.en: Feature Representation Analysis: Table 6 presents the layer wise and average CKA similarity scores between encoder pairs across four selected layers (3, 5, 7, and 11). For the pretrained–continual pair, the encoders exhibit high similarity across all layers, with a gradual decrease in deeper layers, suggesting that LoRA primarily refines high-level semantic representations while inducing task-specific adaptations in later layers.
blocks.zh: 特性代表 分析:表6列出四层编码器对相(3、5、7和11)的层智和平均CKA相似性分数。 对于被预先训练的相继配对,编码器在各个层次上表现出高度的相似性,更深层次逐渐减少,说明LORA主要精炼高层次的语义表述,同时诱发后几层中特定任务的适应.

blocks.en: In the lesion segmentation task, finetuned encoder representations (using pretrained weights) show decreasing similarity to both pretrained and continual pretrained encoders with layer depth. Notably, at the deepest layer, similarity with the continual pretrained encoder increases by approximately 0.4 % 0.4\% , aligning with the observed improvement in segmentation performance (Table 4 ). This supports the hypothesis that continual pretraining facilitates better task-aligned representation learning.
blocks.zh: 在损伤分解任务中,微调编码器的表示(使用被预先训练的重量)显示,与被事先训练的和连续预先训练的具有地层深度的编码器的相似度正在下降。 值得注意的是,在最深层,与持续预先训练的编码器的相类似性增加了约0.4%.0.4%.,与观察到的分解性能的改善相一致(表4)。 这支持一种假设,即持续的预训有助于更好地按照任务调整代表学习。

blocks.en: For the PIRADS classification task, the finetuned encoder remains nearly identical to both pretrained and continual pretrained encoders, implying minimal representational shifts during finetuning. This suggests that classification primarily benefits from globally stable representations rather than layer specific adaptations.
blocks.zh: 就PIRADS分类任务而言,微调编码器仍然与预先训练的和连续的预先训练的编码器几乎完全相同,这意味着微调时的表示变化最小. 这表明,分类主要得益于全球稳定的表述,而不是层层特定的调整。

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we investigated a novel direction of continual pretraining as a means of advancing foundation model development for prostate MRI analysis.
The objective was to enhance task alignment and improve downstream task performance. Our experimental results demonstrate improved and comparable performances in all 6 downstream tasks, two of which involve segmentation, suggesting that task similarity during continual pretraining contributes to improved alignment.
Our Feature analysis results show that, for segmentation tasks, the output feature representations of the continual pretrained encoder exhibit greater similarity to those of the finetuned (initialised from the pretrained) encoder compared to the pretrained encoder itself. This increased representational closeness correlates with the observed performance improvements when finetuning from continual pretrained weights. Conversely, for classification tasks, the representational geometry exhibited minimal change during finetuning, likely due to a stronger focus on fine grained discriminative details, therefore limiting the ability to infer a clear correlation with performance.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们调查了继续预先训练的新方向,作为推进前列腺核磁共振分析基础模型发展的手段。
目的是加强任务协调,并改进下游任务执行情况。 我们的实验结果表明,在所有6个下游任务中,业绩都有所改进并具有可比性,其中2个任务涉及分化,这表明在持续进行预训期间任务相似性有助于改进协调。
我们的特性分析结果表明,对于分解任务来说,持续被预先训练的编码器的输出特性表现与被调整(从预先训练的编码器起步)的编码器本身相比,有更大的相似性。 代表性接近度的提高与所观察到的业绩改善有关,后者在不断调整预先训练的重量时有所改进。 相反地,在分类任务方面,代表性几何在微调时显示的变化很小,这可能是由于更加注重细微的差别性细节,从而限制了推断与性能有明确关联的能力。

blocks.en: Future work may explore integrating a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) approach in the later layers of the encoder to facilitate multi-task continual pretraining and achieve more generalisable task alignment. Moreover, employing alternative representational similarity metrics could provide deeper insights into the impact of continual pretraining on feature representations.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作可能探索在编码器的后几层采用“专家混合”方法,以促进多任务的持续预先培训并实现更通用的任务协调。 此外,采用替代性代表性相似性衡量标准可以更深入地了解持续预先培训对特征表述的影响。
